changes: Long journal entries retain Generate, Delete, Add, Reset and Post Entry at the bottom while scrolling.
Bulk report preparation calculates once after filling the rows. Memo typing skips unchanged arithmetic, and unchanged badges, FX controls and link buttons no longer trigger repeated redraws.
Edited approved reports can recover missing draft source links and post supported fund/category groupings while preserving custom descriptions and server verification of approved amounts.

Generated line memos use item numbers and descriptions. Fund totals use a compact item range; dates, submitter/receipt IDs and source-document references remain in source records rather than being repeated in every memo.
